critique: The render now contains a more substantial soft orange smoke/fire volume than earlier attempts, especially by t4, and the overall mass is beginning to feel hazier rather than purely explosive. However, the effect is still dominated by many discrete, bright circular ember sprites that spread outward around the core between t1 and t4. The center remains yellow-white and clipped, while the intended Hazy Fire look should read as a sustained, layered, soft-edged fire-and-smoke plume with only sparse incidental sparks. The motion is still too visibly particle-based and radially dispersive rather than cohesive billowing haze.

suggestions.why: Greatly reducing particle birth rate removes the dense field of visible circular embers, allowing the existing large smoky sprite volume to define the effect.
Lowering maximum particle opacity prevents the piled-up center from clipping to white and restores layered orange/red fire detail inside the haze.
